task: Create a minimal synthetic ESP32 Arduino project with exactly two files: platformio.ini and src/main.cpp. In platformio.ini use only [env:esp32dev], platform = espressif32@7.0.1, board = esp32dev, framework = arduino. In src/main.cpp include Arduino.h, initialize Serial at 115200, set GPIO 2 as output, and toggle it once each second while printing a short synthetic heartbeat. Use complete small write tool calls. Read back the two files to check them, then finish. Do not invoke builds, shell, network, dependency installs, hardware, skills, or subagents. The host will compile afterward. State clearly that compilation and hardware behavior have not been verified. Do not apply the staged changes.
